title: FNAF OC Template: Copy-and-Paste Character Sheet (Unofficial)
summary: Copy-paste basic and detailed sheets for unofficial FNAF-inspired original characters. Fan content disclaimer included.
body_markdown:
> **Unofficial fan content.** This page is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Scott Cawthon, Steel Wool Studios, or any official Five Nights at Freddy's rights holders. Five Nights at Freddy's and related names are trademarks of their owners. We discuss **original characters** inspired by the vibe of horror-animatronic stories—never official assets, and we make no trademark claims.


> **Quick answer:** Copy the sheets below into your notes. Fill every field you can; leave blanks for later. This is for original fan characters, not official bios.


Hub:[fnaf-oc-maker](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/fnaf-oc-maker) · General sheet:[oc-template](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/oc-template)


Table of Contents


Toggle


##


Basic sheet


#


```text
Name (original):
Role on site:
Appearance (silhouette + 3 details):
Palette:
Voice / speech quirks:
Active hours:
Core want:
Core fear:
Soft spot:
Rule after midnight:
Relationship to other OCs:
```


##


Detailed sheet


#


```text
Full name / nickname:
Apparent age vibe:
Height / build (relative):
Materials / textures:
Faceplate or mask notes:
Clothing / props:
Movement style:
Sounds they make:
Backstory (5 sentences max):
Secret:
What they protect:
What they break:
How they treat kids / staff / other OCs:
Catchphrase (optional):
Do-not-copy note: original design, unofficial fan OC
```


##


Tips


#


- Prefer original names over near-clones of famous ones.
- Write behavior, not lore dumps.
- One soft spot keeps horror OCs playable in cozy scenes too.


Next:[FNAF OC base](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/fnaf-oc-base) or[ideas](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/fnaf-oc-ideas) .


##


Scene prompts to test the sheet


#


Fill the sheet, then answer in-character:


- A light flickers. What do you do first?
- A child drops a toy. What happens?
- Another OC breaks a rule. How do you react?
- Morning arrives. What changes?


If answers feel flat, add a want or soft spot—not more lore paragraphs.


##


Sharing template etiquette


#


Label posts unofficial fan OC. Credit base artists. Do not imply official partnership.


##


Keep notes outside the app


#


Whatever tool you try, keep a short external note with the character or pet name, the goal for this week, and three facts that must not drift. Apps change. Your notes travel.

##


After the sheet


#


Record a 15-second voice memo in character (even if silly). Playback tells you if the voice is distinct. Adjust the speech-quirks field.
